Goty dos gotys, que jogo absurdo, meu top de todos os tempos sem dúvidas, antes eu tinha bastante preconceito com jogo de turno, mas BG3 mudou tudo, e mostrou que combates nesse estilo podem sim ser bastante divertidos, são infinitas classes, subclasses, builds e possibilidades de plays diferentes. Jogo mais rejogável de todos os tempos, é muito fácil ficar horas criando personagem e testando os mods.

Não existe um jogo perfeito, e BG3 tem diversas falhas também, e coisas que eu particularmente mudaria, exemplos:

- O multiplayer é ruim, as custcenes são duplicadas e a sensação que dá é que estamos jogando solo, mas em dois corpos diferentes, e não que são dois personagens diferentes, o que poderia ser muito melhor desenvolvido, como por exemplo no Divinity, que os personagens (até mesmo os oc) interagem entre si, as escolhas realmente afetam na sua personalidade e atributos, as tomadas de decisões são feitas como deveriam ser, em grupo, o que não acontece aqui no BG3.

- Depois que chegamos no nível 12, o jogo fica extremamente fácil (isso considerando o modo estrategista), e perde a emoção na maioria das batalhas, por exemplo, não sentimos mais a emoção e dificuldade de derrotar o "primeiro dos escolhidos" com os demais, é fácil demais quebrar o jogo com algumas builds específicas.

- Poderia ter mais opções de customizações também

- Recompensas melhores em baús e itens após chefes, e também melhorar a parte de criação de elixires etc.

No mais o jogo é goty demais, ao contrário que alguns falam, todos os atos tem conteúdo o suficiente sim para ser um jogo bem extenso, sem necessidade de mod para expandir.

Todo o resto nesse jogo é perfeito, com certeza jogarei muito ainda, e digo só mais uma coisa.

Coçada é o GOAT.

Lots of impressive technical and artistic work in this, but I never got around to finishing it because it's so repetitive and grindy. I was really hopeful at the start of the game, because it throws you into an insane set of gameplay segments/cutscenes blending esoteric D&D lore w/ H.R. Giger-style horror, plus a compelling multi-planar crash sequence. However, after that point it becomes bog-standard narrative-wise and the combat can be very tedious. The inclusion of the  dice roll mechanic in particular indicates a fundamental misunderstanding of the medium. Random dice rolls work well in D&D because failing checks can be just as interesting as succeeding (for instance, failing an important deception check against the king and then being sentenced to death--what will our intrepid heroes(?) do?), since the DM can creatively adapt as the situation evolves. In Baldur's Gate, however, the flow of the game is more or less fixed. Which means, with no DM to turn a flubbed role into a comedic or dramatic opportunity, low rolls are almost exclusively a source of frustration. If there has to be randomness, it should at most be Pokemon-style, where (very) occasionally someone can get a crit or whiff an attack. Also, the fact that you can't pick off enemies without initiating combat is really annoying. The amount of resource rationing you have to go through due to being forced to churn through unavoidable encounter after unavoidable encounter is quite draining (at least until you can build up some reserves later in the run).

Baldur’s Gate 3, sadece yılın değil, oyun tarihinin en başarılı ve en kapsamlı Rol Yapma Oyunlarından (RPG) biri. Larian Studios’un Zindanlar ve Ejderhalar (D&D 5e) kurallarını dijital dünyaya entegre ederken sergilediği özgürlük anlayışı, oyun dünyasında çıtayı ulaşılması zor bir noktaya taşıyor.

Yapımı bir başyapıt haline getiren ve yüzlerce saatlik deneyim sunan temel özellikler şunlar:

Sonsuz Yeniden Oynanabilirlik (Replayability): Baldur’s Gate 3, "bir kez bitirip kenara atılacak" yapımlardan kesinlikle değil. Oyunu tamamladıktan sonra bile alacağınız farklı kararlar, seçeceğiniz farklı Origin karakterleri veya baştan yaratacağınız yepyeni bir ırk/sınıf kombinasyonu ile yüz saati aşan tamamen yeni bir macera yaşayabilirsiniz.

Seçim Özgürlüğü ve Gerçek Kararlar: Oyunda aldığınız en küçük kararın bile dünyada ve hikayenin akışında doğrudan bir karşılığı var. Bir karakteri hayatta bırakmanız veya öldürmeniz, diyaloglarda seçeceğiniz bir cümle ya da bir zarda gelen sayı, onlarca saat sonra karşınıza çıkacak görevleri ve dünyadaki dengeleri kökten değiştirebiliyor. Hikayeyi "iyi", "kötü" ya da tamamen kaos odaklı oynamak tamamen sizin elinizde.

Esnek ve Çeşitli Oynanış Tarzları: Karakterinizi oluştururken sunduğu inanılmaz çeşitlilik, çatışma anlarına da doğrudan yansıyor. Düşmanlarınızla kaba kuvvetle savaşabilir, gizlilikle arkalarından sızabilir, çevre unsurlarını (yüksek zemin avantajı, patlayıcı fıçılar, element kombinasyonları) kullanarak taktiksel üstünlük kurabilir ya da savaşları hiç başlatmadan sadece ikna/hile yeteneklerinizle diyalog üzerinden çözebilirsiniz.

Derin Yoldaş (Companion) İlişkileri: Yanınıza aldığınız yoldaşların her biri kendine ait derin geçmişe, ahlaki değerlere ve kişisel görev dizilimlerine sahip. Onlarla kuracağınız dostluklar, romantik ilişkiler ya da aranızda yaşanabilecek anlaşmazlıklar oyunun hikaye anlatımını inanılmaz derecede zenginleştiriyor.

Özetle; Baldur’s Gate 3, oyuncuya hayal gücünün sınırlarını zorlama imkanı veren, her oynanışta bambaşka kapılar açan ve RPG türünün zirvesini temsil eden zamansız bir başyapıt.

Existem jogos que você termina e existem jogos que levam um pedacinho de você quando chegam ao fim. Baldur’s Gate 3 foi, sem dúvida, o segundo tipo.

Foram tantas horas, tantas histórias, tantas escolhas e tantos momentos que, em algum ponto, deixei de enxergar aqueles personagens como simples companheiros de aventura. Passei a me importar genuinamente com cada um deles, com suas dores, seus medos, suas contradições e, principalmente, com a possibilidade de encontrarem um pouco de felicidade depois de tudo que viveram.

Cada personagem tem uma história que merece ser ouvida. Cada despedida tem seu peso. Cada pequena conquista parece uma vitória compartilhada. E talvez seja isso que mais me marcou: perceber que, mesmo em um mundo tão cruel, ainda existe espaço para amizade, amor, perdão e esperança.

Não foi apenas uma jornada para derrotar um grande mal. Foi uma jornada sobre pessoas tentando encontrar seu lugar no mundo, sobre aprender a escolher por si mesmo e sobre não abandonar aqueles que caminham ao seu lado.

Termino essa aventura com o coração cheio, uma saudade que já começou e a sensação de que algumas histórias nunca terminam de verdade.

Obrigado, Baldur’s Gate 3, por me fazer amar tanto esse mundo e, principalmente, as pessoas que encontrei nele.

After dropping it the first time I launched it because of that, I'm so so glad that I gave it a second chance. It's one of those games that leaves you empty and wanting for more after you finish it. The thrill of making a character thinking out their backstory and sticking to it is rare to find in recent games. If you were to adhere to said characters backstory it leads to a unique experience of the story each time.

There is an enormous amount of love that Larian poured into the making of literally every single aspect of this game and it shows in every act. The dialogue is engaging and well-thought out it, making the player interested in talking to every minor NPC. The characters are very memorable and easy to empathize with. The combat, while hard at first feels very rewarding when you get the hang of it. The music is a joy to the ears. The story is gripping and rich. Literally a manual on how to make an amazing and memorable experience. I can continue piling on positives, but I'll instead encourage you to buy it and experience it for yourself, even at full price. You WILL not regret it.

PS. I only have one teeny-tiny gripe with this game - what in the fuck is the drop weapons mechanic that fighter classes punish you with like a dominatrix punishes their cuckboy?! I have lost multiple hours of progress in-part because of my brain damage to not notice my missing legendary weapons in my inventory in the next encounter, wondering why I do no damage. Of course, that's just me being a whiny bitch. 

BUY THE GAME

This review has spoilers.
Let me paint you a picture:

You're abducted by aliens and get probed. A little while after you escape, a voice inside your head that wasn't there prior to probing starts encouraging you to seek out other probes to shove inside yourself. Much literature is written about how bad being probed is, every medical professional you speak to agrees you should deprobe yourself pronto otherwise you'll die, and you start to suffer nightmares and have hallucinations.

You now have a choice:

a) listen to all of the information presented to you and attempt deprobing / do not engage with further probing

b) listen to the new voice in your head and continue collecting probes to insert into yourself in exchange for neat magic powers. When you use the probes, a little visual pops up of your brain turning to goo, but don't worry about that.

This is the core conundrum the game presents. Sell your body and soul for power, or abstain. Guess where it leads?

Nowhere. There's no negative outcome for sacrificing your humanity outside of a single pass/fail roll that you can reattempt via save/reload. If you fail, the worst that happens is a minor cosmetic change in the last leg of the game. Your choice to take the game's negative presentation of "probing" at face value actively makes your gameplay less varied by locking yourself out of a useful skill tree, and it has little to no bearing on the trajectory of the plot or the ending you receive.

This is BG3 in a nutshell: a strong opening that stumbles so hard in the final lap that it actively undermines everything that came before.

The combat is initially fun, but the encounter design and AI vulnerabilities frequently reward repetitive chokepoint kiting and leans heavily on initiative, leading to interesting encounters having a handful of solutions. 

Companions start interesting, until you find that each one you meet past the 4th got less and less dev time.

You get the point. 

The game is frontloaded, and the accolades it's had heaped upon it have set an extreamly high bar that it doesn't quite hit. It's a 7.5 out of 10 if you're cool with the plot kneecapping both itself and your agency in the final leg, a 6/10 if you value your cerebrum.

A final story: there's an eldritch chair a companion can sit on that is supposed to remove the probe. You can make a series of choices that result in the companion getting multiple permanent debuffs. The only way to cure the debuffs is convincing the companion, who is dogmatically opposed to probing, to accept a probing. If you don't, these debuffs will cripple them until the end of the game.

The length of time you allow a companion to sit in a chair has stronger ramifications than offering chunks of yourself up to a hive mind alien. That's BG3.

Baldur's Gate 3 — 130 часов, одно прохождение
Почему одно?
Не люблю перепроходить игры в принципе, а уж тем более RPG. Нет столько времени. И выбор есть выбор — история, которую я уже выбрал, пусть и остаётся со всеми ошибками.

Общее впечатление
Это CRPG с тонной возможностей, если вы этого хотите. А если нет — можете в принципе идти напролом. Расписывать все плюсы и минусы механик спустя столько времени после релиза смысла нет. Но кое-что сказать всё же хочется.

Третий акт — и это не новость
«Город с тысячами возможностей» — это правда. Но для тех, кто хочет закрыть все квесты, это прямо испытание. И ещё тысячу раз посетишь каналазацию. ))) Бои в заключительном акте идут постоянно и в конце уже начинают утомлять. Благо линии Астариона и Шэдоухарт, как по мне, сделаны чуть ли не лучше основного сюжета. А по балансу первый акт всё-таки самый лучший.

Про бои
В третьем акте всё разнообразие сводится к тому, что на тебя вываливают тонну мобов, и любой бой занимает кучу времени. По сути, ты просто вливаешь АОЕ-дамаг в эти кучи. Да, можно разлить масло, кинуть бочку, разлить масло и туда кинуть бочку с порохом. Но это два действия. Проще бахнуть АОЕ-скиллами. В первых двух актах ты ищешь возможности нестандартной расправы. А в третьем — это уже душит. Снова третий акт, про который только ленивый не написал.

Сюжет
Он хороший. Но не вау. Сначала интригует,потом он просто хорош. А после стандартное фентези,где сюжетные линии особо то и не связаны между собой, а потом игра так и не отвечает: а кто такой, нахрен, этот Иссохший? 
Какой-то рваный отзыв получился ,где-то хорошо,а где то нет. В принципе как и сама игра. Не смотря на долгое время разработки ,Лариан явно много всего не доделали либо доделывали прям на ходу сшивая белыми нитками. Делает ли это игру плохой ? ни капли!

Рекомендую ли?
Скорее да. Я сам в тактики давно не играл, и Балдура стала первой со времён, наверное, PS3. Здесь всё-таки хороший сюжет. Если выставите сложность повыше, бои будут сложнее и дольше (хотя куда уже дольше). А если уж любите тактики — тем более стоит поиграть.

Baldur's Gate 3 is, without question, the most ambitious RPG in history. I think back to November 11th, 2011, the day The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim released. BG3 is like Skyrim to me. I played Skyrim on the day of its release, and since that day (for the past 15 years), I have always had at least one copy of Skyrim. I have logged many, MANY hours into that game across many different consoles. For a long time it's been considered (arguably) the most ambitious RPG ever. I think Baldur's Gate 3 has handily taken that title and ran away with it. There may not be another game on the same caliber as BG3 for years to come. It's a truly special experience, to be so free as to choose from so many different branching paths and know that your choices do actually matter, and will lead you to an ending you may not have ever seen otherwise. Few video games can truly claim to do such a thing, and Baldur's Gate 3 does it better than any other video game ever made.

Baldur's Gate 3 überzeugt mit einer wunderschönen Grafik, einer lebendigen und detaillierten Spielwelt sowie einer guten Atmosphäre. Jede Region wirkt liebevoll gestaltet und lädt zum Erkunden ein. Die Welt fühlt sich glaubwürdig an und steckt voller kleiner Geschichten und interessanter Charaktere.

Auch die Spielbarkeit ist hervorragend. Das rundenbasierte Kampfsystem ist angenehm entschleunigt, leicht zugänglich und gleichzeitig taktisch genug, um langfristig Spaß zu machen. Kämpfe fühlen sich selten stressig an und geben einem die Möglichkeit, in Ruhe verschiedene Strategien auszuprobieren.

Was mich jedoch enttäuscht hat, ist die Hauptgeschichte. Der Fokus auf Gedankenschinder (Mind Flayer) und die gesamte Handlung rund um die Parasiten und Illithiden nimmt für meinen Geschmack zu viel Raum ein. Gerade im D&D-Universum hätte ich mir eine vielseitigere Bedrohung und eine abwechslungsreichere Story gewünscht. Hier hatte ich deutlich mehr erwartet.

Trotz dieses Kritikpunkts bleibt Baldur's Gate 3 ein sehr gutes Rollenspiel mit beeindruckender Präsentation, viel Freiheit und hohem Spielspaß. Die Story konnte mich jedoch nicht in dem Maß begeistern wie die Grafik, die Welt und das Gameplay.

If you go into this thinking you've beaten elden ring or play an mmo or moba at a high level so you got this, you don't. Dungeon and dragons is unique af as far as rpg video games goes. I spent somewhere around 20 hours of research on this game's mechanics. I've never played dungeons and dragons and knew nothing about it going in. Builds matter! If you dont know what something does, google it. Lightning charges, reverberation, action points, action order and spell slots. Everything matters and some builds MUST have specific action orders to get the big damage numbers. Save often! Auto saves are sometimes spaced out by like 20 min depending on what path you take or if you like to explore they can be longer. That doesn't include dialogue or combat time either and if you fail an important check or get ambushed, that reload could set you back an hour or even longer. I say longer because I had a House of Grief fight go on for 30 min only to lose concentration by slipping on ice that the stupid movement path was not red over. Tried to walk as close as possible to get those extra few steps to break line of sight lol. But in the end, it was so worth it! Couldn't recommend this game more. 10/10
